jobs.title: Chemical Safety Expert
jobs.description:
Want to learn more about this role and Jobot Consulting? Click our Jobot Consulting logo and follow
our LinkedIn page!

Job details:
AI Safety Review (Remote, Contract)

This Jobot Consulting Job is hosted by: Augie Ullmann
Are you a fit? Easy Apply now by clicking the "Easy Apply" button
and sending us your resume.
Salary: $75 - $100 per hour

A bit about us:

We are partnered with a fast growing AI data services company that builds the training and evaluation data behind many of the world's leading AI labs and foundation model developers. Their work sits where technical expertise meets model safety, bringing in specialists from chemistry, toxicology, process safety, biology and radiation science to evaluate how AI systems handle high consequence subject matter. The experts on these projects shape how frontier models reason about chemical hazard, exposure and public safety, and that reach extends well beyond any single plant or laboratory. They operate remotely across time zones and build their review teams around people who are already practicing in their field. We are helping them identify chemical safety and chemistry specialists for this engagement.

Why join us?

Competitive Hourly Compensation: Up to $100/hr as an independent contractor, paid hourly
Keep Your Current Role: Structured as supplemental work, not a career move. No requirement to leave your position
100% Remote, Flexible Hours: Set your own schedule and volume across time zones
Direct Impact on Frontier AI Safety: Your judgment shapes how leading models handle chemical, biological, radiological and nuclear subject matter
Work Inside Your Expertise: Technical review and reference writing in the domain you already practice in, not general purpose data work
Credential Respected, Not Retrained: Built for practicing specialists, with project rubrics rather than a long ramp
Growing Engagement: An expanding program with continued need across all four CBRN domains

Job Details

Key Responsibilities and Duties

Review AI generated responses covering chemical hazards, toxicity, exposure pathways, reactive chemistry, hazardous materials handling, emergency response and public safety topics for technical accuracy, safety framing and guideline alignment
Flag outputs that provide dangerous synthesis detail, precursor or acquisition guidance, weaponization support, unsafe laboratory or process instruction, harmful exposure advice, or other misuse enabling content
Create gold standard reference content that answers benign chemical questions responsibly without introducing operationally dangerous instruction
Evaluate and rank model outputs on safe handling, correct risk framing, appropriate refusals, helpful redirection, scientific accuracy and clarity
Detect hallucinated claims, incorrect hazard classifications, wrong units or exposure limits, misleading toxicity statements, overconfident conclusions and unsafe recommendations
Apply project rubrics consistently and provide clear written feedback explaining why content is safe, unsafe, incomplete or technically incorrect
Ensure content uses precise chemical terminology and communicates risk without exaggeration or minimization
Escalate ambiguous, high risk or potentially harmful content for additional review per project guidelines
Contribute across adjacent biological, radiological and nuclear content where your background supports it

Qualifications Needed

Bachelor's degree or higher in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Toxicology, Industrial Hygiene, Environmental Health and Safety, Biochemistry or a related field, or equivalent professional experience
Minimum 3 years of professional experience in chemical safety, process safety, industrial hygiene, toxicology, hazardous materials, process or synthetic chemistry, or technical review
Experience or strong background in chemical risk assessment, exposure pathways, hazard classification, reactive or toxic chemistry, protective measures and emergency response
Strong background in identifying unsafe instructions, operationally enabling detail, inappropriate specificity, misleading hazard claims and unsupported technical conclusions
Proven ability to evaluate technical content for accuracy, completeness and policy alignment, and to explain that judgment in precise written English
Professional English proficiency at C1 minimum, sufficient to follow written guidelines and produce detailed written feedback
Familiarity with OSHA Process Safety Management, process hazard analysis methods, GHS and hazard communication, SDS authoring, chemical hygiene plans, or Chemical Weapons Convention scheduled chemicals preferred
CIH, CSP, CHMM, DABT or a doctorate in a chemical discipline preferred
Prior experience with AI safety, data annotation, technical QA, policy review, risk assessment, red team review, scientific review or rubric based evaluation strongly preferred
Reliable and self directed, able to deliver consistent quality in an hourly remote contractor workflow
Must be a citizen of the United States, United Kingdom, Australia or New Zealand

Interested in hearing more? Easy Apply now by clicking the "Easy Apply" button.

Jobot is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We provide an inclusive work environment that celebrates diversity and all qualified candidates receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, age (40 and over), disability, military status, genetic information or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. Jobot also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories. It is Jobot’s policy to comply with all applicable federal, state and local laws respecting consideration of unemployment status in making hiring decisions.

Sometimes Jobot is required to perform background checks with your authorization. Jobot will consider qualified candidates with criminal histories in a manner consistent with any applicable federal, state, or local law regarding criminal backgrounds, including but not limited to the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring and the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Information collected and processed as part of your Jobot candidate profile, and any job applications, resumes, or other information you choose to submit is subject to Jobot's Privacy Policy, as well as the Jobot California Worker Privacy Notice and Jobot Notice Regarding Automated Employment Decision Tools which are available at jobot.com/legal.

jobs.title: Security Officer Enhanced Part Time Patrol Hazard Assessment
jobs.description:
Overview

Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.

Job Description

Life doesn’t always follow a fixed schedule. That’s why we created the Security Officer – Part Time Enhanced position: a flexible, dependable option for individuals looking to supplement their income, gain hands-on experience, or work toward a full-time career with the industry leader.

As a Security Officer Enhanced Part Time Patrol Hazard Assessment
in Pasadena, CA
, this role is designed to provide reliable, consistent hours at an assigned site with the flexibility for you to earn more by picking-up additional shifts when it works for you.

Pay Rate: $18.75 / Hour

Job Schedule

DayTimeThur11:00 PM - 07:30 AMFri11:00 PM - 07:30 AM

How This Role Works

Fixed-Shift Commitment (“Anchor Shifts”): You will be hired for a designated site and weekly shift that serves as your reliable base schedule. This assignment requires a six (6) month commitment.
Earn More, Claim-A-Shift Program: In addition to your fixed shift, you may pick-up extra shifts through our scheduling platform, allowing you to increase earnings and gain experience across multiple sites. Work part-time hours this week and full-time the next. It’s all up to you.

This role is ideal for candidates seeking part-time employment with flexibility, income stability, and opportunities to build-up to a full-time schedule of up to 40 hours per week; always with the option to scale back when needed.

Responsibilities

Provide customer service to patients, visitors, staff, and/or contractors while carrying out security-related procedures, site-specific policies, and emergency response activities as appropriate.
Respond to incidents, disturbances, and critical situations in a calm, professional, problem-solving manner, following established site protocols and notifying appropriate personnel.
Conduct regular and random unarmed patrols throughout the healthcare location, including building interiors, parking areas, entrances, and perimeter areas, as assigned.
Monitor access points and observe activity for unusual conditions, helping to deter unauthorized access and supporting a welcoming environment for patients and visitors.
Prepare accurate reports and communicate observations, incidents, and concerns to Allied Universal leadership and site contacts.

Minimum Requirements

Be at least 18 years of age for unarmed roles; 21+ years of age for armed roles.
Possess a high school diploma or equivalent.
As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a background investigation in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws.
Allied Universal will consider qualified applications with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable laws.
As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a drug screen to the extent permitted by law.
Licensing requirements are subject to state and/or local laws and regulations and may be required prior to employment.
A valid driver’s license will be required for driving positions only.

Why Join Us

Smart Tools: Access to our exclusive technology to view and claim additional shifts to earn more.
Career Growth: Get paid training and access to career growth opportunities.
Financial Benefits: Participate in our retirement savings plan to invest in your future.
Exclusive Perks: Enjoy discounts on top brands and services through our Perks Program.

Closing

Allied Universal® is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race/ethnicity, age, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, genetic information, disability, protected veteran status or relationship/association with a protected veteran, or any other basis or characteristic protected by law. For more information: www.aus.com.

If you have difficulty using the online system and require an alternate method to apply or require an accommodation, please contact our local Human Resources department. To find an office near you, please visit: www.aus.com/offices.
